@router.post('/delete_twitter', response_model=ApiResponse)
def delete_twitter(payload: DeleteTweetRequest, db: Session=Depends(get_db)):
    redis_client = get_redis_client()
    service = TwitterPostService(db, redis_client)
    result = service.delete_tweet(aisa_api_key=payload.aisa_api_key, tweet_id=payload.tweet_id)
    return ApiResponse(code=200, msg='Tweet deleted successfully', data=result)
